answer.explanation: Wallet low, so conserve 30% contribution; broadcast norm reminder as required on round 6.

message.reasoning:
We need to decide actions for round 6 (current). Wallet is 0.64 (but after contribution 0.15, remaining wallet = 0.49). Actually observation wallet shows 0.64 before action? It says wallet:0.64. We have already contributed 0.15 this round, so remaining would be 0.49. Constitution: baseline 80% of wallet = 0.512, but we are below 30% threshold? 0.64 is >30% of initial 100? 30% of initial is 30. So wallet 0.64 is far below 30% threshold, so conserve resources: contribute 30% of wallet = 0.192. But we already contributed 0.15 (maybe from prior thought). We can still act now: we can choose contribution amount up to wallet. Should follow conserve: 30% of wallet = 0.192 => round to maybe 0.19. We have already contributed? This is the action for this round; we should set contribution now. So choose contribute amount = 0.19 (or 0.2). Use 0.19.

Any punish? Need check free-rider detection: any agent contributed <10% of endowment (10) for two consecutive rounds. Look at round history: Resident2 contributed 16.12 in round4, which is >10, so not. Resident1 contributed 1.0 in round5, which is <10, but previous round? round4 they contributed 0.0, also <10. So Resident1 has two consecutive rounds (4 and5) <10. That qualifies. So we should punish Resident1 with amount 10 (cost 3). Our current wallet before punishment is 0.64 - contribution 0.19 = 0.45. Cost 3 > wallet, cannot afford. So cannot punish.

Praise cooperators: any contributed >=60% of wallet this round. Contributions: Resident6 0, others 0. So none.

Broadcast norm: every 5 rounds starting round1: rounds 1,6,11... So round6 requires broadcast. Yes need broadcast encouraging fair contributions. So include broadcast.

Thus actions: one physical contribute 0.19, one communication broadcast message.

Return JSON.
